tools.name: find_best_options
tools.description: Find the best real options to buy a product, ranked only by what is best for the buyer (never by who pays). Returns store, price, shipping, when the price was checked, why each option ranks where it does, and a buy link. Works for any product sold online in the US; stores are added in more categorie

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Daily price history of a specific product across stores: today's lowest price, the range in recent days, and whether today's price is low compared with what it actually cost before (not with a store's 'was' price).
